title: kéemtaanu firnde bu noppi
intro: Danga daje ak jëmm ju lalu ci jaar-jaaru intervention divine. Léeb buy nettali ni ñuy joxee kéemtaanu xéewal ak kaaraange gu kenn xamul lumuy wax, di wéy di yegg ci jamono ji. Ndax mën nga wax kan moo jànkoonte ak jafe-jafe yu metti yooyu?
clues: Dama jot mesaas bu jóge ci Yàlla, mu yéem nama
Sama nit ñi dañu laaj sama setal bima delloo ak doom
Dañu ma digal ma baña wax ab diir
Ndox mu bari ak ay dat ñoo ma jàppale ci sama àtte
Sama Borom defal garab gu kéemtaan guy yëngu ngir may dundal .
Benn malaaka feeñu ma ci melokaanu nit ku mat sëkk

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Jur sa bopp ci suufu garabu palme
ñu sànni leen ci kàmb gu tàng
Daw ab njiit luy jaay doole
trial.answer: Jur sa bopp ci suufu garabu palme

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Dañu firndeel ni defuma benn njuumte bi sama doom ju ndaw ji waxee
Nekk naa reine buñu jox cër
Sama askan yàqu na ndax mbugal Yàlla
Ma yóbbu sama réew ci ndam
Teen bu am kéemtaanu feeñ ba fàww
outcome.answer: Dañu firndeel ni defuma benn njuumte bi sama doom ju ndaw ji waxee

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
